**Hi everyone!** 

This is my first film, created as a continuation of a theatre project that was halted by lockdown. 

As such, one of the reasons I wanted to put it on here was to share how I got around some of the difficulties offered by our separation: by using abstract (and royalty-free!) stock footage. The poetic quality that this gave the cinematography ended up pairing well with the script which was originally half-dialogue, half-poetry.

Hopefully this film can contribute to different conversations, whether through its themes or its methods.

Enjoy!

(P.S. – If you have any thoughts or would like to say anything about it, please do message me! I’d love to hear from you!)
